component.name: USB Music Organizer
component.summary: Organize and sequence audio collections for varied USB playback

description.p: USB Music Organizer is a desktop application built with Python and PySide6/Qt that fixes monotonous playback on embedded media players and vehicle head units.

The app analyzes and restructures music folders using a dynamic sorting algorithm that alternates genres, artists, and tempos to deliver a balanced, shuffled-style playback directly from USB flash drives.
